purpose: Qualification STRUCTURE of record: papers (codes, raw maxima, durations), official weightings, the derivation of the graded total, and award rules. Every value is transcribed from the sha256-pinned official specification documents below; boundary VALUES stay governed exclusively by the sha256-recorded grade-boundary documents in raw/ (per-series source blocks in the bundle). The weighted total cross-check against a boundaries document is recorded per course.

sources.title: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE in Mathematics (Specification B) — Specification, Issue 1, January 2016
sources.usedFor: Assessment requirements table: paper codes 4MB1/01 and 4MB1/02, 100 marks each, Paper 1 weighted 33 1/3% (1h 30m), Paper 2 weighted 66 2/3% (2h 30m), both Higher tier

sources.title: Pearson Grade Boundaries — June 2026 International GCSE (9-1)
sources.usedFor: Cross-check: the 4MB1 subject row prints maxMark 300 with overall 9-1 boundaries on the weighted total (papers 01 02 / 01R 02R)

total.note: Paper 2 counts double: the graded total is 300 weighted marks (100 from Paper 1, 200 from Paper 2), not 200 raw marks.

awardRules.note: Linear 9-1 qualification: no unit-grade or A* aggregate conditions; grades 9..1 are awarded directly on the weighted total per session.
